summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Phase 4C ComfortPreferencesShell component and preview harness. All contract requirements verified and passing. Shell is pure presentation with no backend API calls (as required by scope).

backend_issues.notes: Backend testing explicitly skipped per task scope — NO /api/comfort* endpoints should exist (forbidden by Phase 4C contract). Template backend /api/ endpoint working as expected.

passed_tests: Home page loads with link to preview (data-testid: home-shell-preview-link)
Amber 'presentation only' banner displays with contract reference
Three scenario pills present and functional (locked, empty, filled)
Consent-lock state: editor locked, grant button present, badge shows 'Locked'
Empty state: consent active, no profile banner visible, editor unlocked, badge shows 'Consent active'
Filled state: pre-filled preferences (Cool, Soft, Quiet), notes textarea populated, empty banner hidden
CRITICAL: Verbatim copy is BYTE-EXACT - 'Withdrawing consent hides your comfort profile from providers. Your data is not deleted.'
Withdraw and Delete are separate buttons with distinct copy (hide vs permanent)
All callbacks emit correctly: onGrantConsent(), onSavePreferences(data), onWithdrawConsent(), onDeleteProfile()
Temperature, lighting, noise selection interactions work correctly
Notes textarea input and save functionality verified
Shell purity verified: ZERO network calls to /api/comfort* endpoints
Status badge updates correctly across all scenarios
All required data-testids present and functional
